result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but there are a few visible layout issues around clipped horizontal content and the fixed bottom navigation overlapping feed content.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant feed. The second 'Popular right now' card is partially hidden behind the nav, making the lower portion of the card/image difficult to see.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area inset to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable sections are abruptly clipped at the right edge, including the category chips and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards. A partial chip/card is visible with no visual affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge, stronger scroll affordance, or adjust spacing so partially visible items look intentional.

issues.description: The third restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off, including its image and name, which reads only partially as 'Trattoria Piccol...'.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have consistent visible widths and allow enough spacing so partially shown cards do not make text look unintentionally truncated.
